notes: Dated PDF (Jan 27, 2026) linked from the restaurant's own Squarespace site, clean text layer with names and prices paired throughout. Reached sections: Lunch Specials, Appetizers, Salad Meals, Soup, Sticky Rice and Meat, Dinner Entrees, Thai Pan Specials, Thai Pan Combo Meals, Thai Pan Kids Meals, Sides, Desserts, Beverages. Lunch Specials and Dinner Entrees are protein-tier pricing (price set by protein choice; a list of ~14-16 named dish styles share that price with no individual upcharge) -- recorded the priced protein tiers, not each style name, per playbook guidance on build-your-own pricing. Curry Lover add-ons and the Dinner-section 'Noodles and Fried Rice Dishes' list carry no standalone prices (they are style add-ons within the Dinner Entree price) and were excluded rather than guessed. One 'Sticky Rice and Meat' row (Garlic wing with sticky rice) had no price recoverable from the column-scrambled layout and was dropped rather than assumed equal to its neighbors.

The restaurant's own site (kilowatt.beer) publishes NO priced menu anywhere -- /food-menus/ and /happy-hour/ pages describe kitchen hours and happy-hour deals in prose only, with zero per-item prices; a photo gallery of food shots exists but is not a priced board. FOOD ITEMS (sausages, pretzels, mac-and-cheese, sliders per web search) have NO price source found anywhere -- own site, Grubhub, TapHunter (drinks-only), and RestaurantGuru (2 stray $ matches, not a menu) were all checked. The JSON-LD's 'Most Ordered' section (12 items) duplicated items already listed under their real category at identical prices -- dropped as duplicates, keeping the specific-section copy. Markup check: prices end in .99/.59 uniformly (e.g. $24.99, $21.99, $15.99, $3.59) with no clean landing when divided by 1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.04 -- consistent with standard chain psychological pricing, not a delivery surcharge. Reached 8 sections: Salads, Create Your Own Pizza, Specialty Pies, Super Specialty Pies, Calzones, Beverages, Sides, Sandwiches -- this is DoorDash's full published listing for the store; no independent priced source was available to cross-check against.

name: Fifth & Rose
notes: Pendry San Diego hotel restaurant (550 J Street, confirmed in the beer/wine and cocktail page footers, matching the work list address exactly). Own site serves three separate, fully priced, server-rendered menu pages (dinner, cocktail, beer & wine) with clean class-based markup (dining-menu__item-name/description/price) -- parsed directly, no browser needed. Dinner: 11 savory items + 3 desserts (2 sections: Menu, Dessert). Cocktail: 17 cocktails across 7 era-themed sections (Golden Age, Prohibition Era, Post War, Tiki, Dark Ages, Enduring Classics, Ultra Premium). Beer & Wine: draft beer plus sparkling/rose/white/red wine by the glass and/or bottle; two 'Exquisite Bottled' sections (Champagne, Red Wine) repeated 7 wines already listed at identical prices under Sparkling Wine/Red Wine -- deduped, kept one copy each. Items priced both by Glass and Bottle (e.g. Moet & Chandon, Chateau D'Esclans) recorded as two separate rows. This is a fine-dining hotel restaurant with no separate lunch/breakfast menu found on the site -- Fifth & Rose's own page only links these three menus, so this is treated as the complete published set, not a partial daypart capture.
